Item Class: Stackable Currency
Rarity: Currency
Greater Essence of the Body
--------
Stack Size: 2/10
--------
Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding a guaranteed modifier
--------
Body Armour: +(70-84) to maximum Life
Belt: +(70-84) to maximum Life
--------
Right click this item then left click a Magic item to apply it.
Shift click to unstack.
